hpi: This case demonstrates the importance of a thorough history and physical examination in the evaluation of headache. It is critical to differentiate primary headaches from secondary causes, as this will guide management and treatment. In this case, the patient presented with a classic cluster headache, which is characterized by unilateral, severe pain, often associated with autonomic symptoms. The management of cluster headaches includes abortive and preventive therapies, and understanding the patient's history is essential in tailoring the treatment plan.
